name: Natural Zero+ ~Hajimari to Owari no Basho de~
original_name: NaturalZero+ ～はじまりと終わりの場所で～
source:
Our main character is a young and hopeful novelist. He has been uselessly wasting his life away following the death of his younger sister, Yoshino. Our hero is forced to stay in an old decrepit apartment provided by his publishing company. Here, he meets Marino, who remarkably resembles his young sister. They begin living together in the apartment. Shortly after, our hero learns that Marino is the half-sister to Ayane, the chief editor of the magazine he writes for. Marino proves to be poor at housework, but she is completely devoted to our hero. Notwithstanding Marino's cheerfulness, our hero comes to find out that she holds a very dark and bitter memory she is unwilling to recall. Enjoy your short summer with Marino! Following the feature presentation, you will find a side-story about the girls from "Natural-Both Body and Heart" and "Natural 2-DUO-." You will find more information concerning Ayane's life, along with the characters Chitose and Sora. 

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020414153513fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/natural-zero/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一位年轻而充满希望的小说家。自从妹妹芳乃去世后，他一直浑浑噩噩地虚度光阴。主人公被迫住进出版社提供的一间破旧公寓。在那里，他遇见了与妹妹极为相似的真里乃。两人开始了公寓里的同居生活。不久之后，主人公得知真里乃是他所供职杂志的主编绫音的同父异母妹妹。真里乃在家务方面笨手笨脚，但对主人公全心全意。尽管真里乃性格开朗，主人公却发现她心中藏着一段不愿回忆的黑暗而苦涩的记忆。与真里乃共度短暂的夏日吧！在正篇之后，还有关于《Natural-身心交融》和《Natural 2-DUO-》中女孩们的支线故事。你将了解到更多关于绫音的人生，以及角色千岁和空的信息。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020414153513fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/natural-zero/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
